description: Error fingerprinting and deduplication for ErrorHistory. Fingerprint composition: SHA-256(error_code + ':' + top_frame_hash + ':' + sanitized_message_template). Sanitization replaces UUID, ISO 8601 timestamps, and integers >= 4 digits with placeholders, lowercases, and trims. Two errors with the same fingerprint MUST collapse into a single ErrorEntry (count incremented, last_seen_at updated). Different error_code values MUST produce distinct fingerprints. The top_frame_hash field is computed from the first non-framework stack frame; for the purpose of this fixture, callers SHOULD substitute caller_id when stack traces are unavailable. See docs/features/observability.md#error-fingerprinting and #14-error-fingerprinting-for-deduplication.
